headline: Sea Pines Access and Beach Parking Management
reservation: Entrance to the Sea Pines Forest Preserve requires a daily vehicle gate fee paid at the Sea Pines Resort community entrance. Most beach access is public, but parking at Coligny and Folly Field fills early; no reservations exist for public spots. Verify seasonal beach trolley schedules for alternative transit to the shore.

days.title: Atlantic Shoreline and Maritime Forest

stops.name: Coligny Beach Park
stops.detail: Rent a beach cruiser to ride on the hard-packed sand at low tide along the Atlantic coast.

stops.name: Sea Pines Forest Preserve
stops.detail: Walk the boardwalks to view the 4,000-year-old Sea Pines Shell Ring and local wetlands.

days.driving: Walking or cycling is primary; local transfers take 15-20 mins
days.note: Always check the tide chart before biking on the beach to ensure the sand is firm.

days.title: Salt Marsh Ecology and Gullah Culture

stops.name: Coastal Discovery Museum
stops.detail: Explore the 68-acre historic property featuring ancient cedars and Gullah heritage exhibits.

stops.name: Pinckney Island National Wildlife Refuge
stops.detail: Observe migratory birds and alligators along the gravel trails of this former plantation.

days.driving: Allow 30 mins; conditions vary with bridge traffic
days.note: Pinckney Island has no potable water; bring adequate supplies for the sun-exposed trails.

days.title: Harbor Vistas and Lowcountry Waterways

stops.name: Shelter Cove Marina
stops.detail: Join a guided kayak tour through the salt marshes to look for resident bottlenose dolphins.

stops.name: Harbour Town Lighthouse
stops.detail: Climb the iconic striped tower for a view across the Calibogue Sound toward Daufuskie Island.

days.note: Harbour Town is within a gated community; factor in the entry fee and pedestrian-only zones.

intel.title: Morning Beach Rush
intel.text: Public beach lots at Folly Field and Coligny often fill by 10 AM in summer. Utilize the Breeze Trolley to avoid parking shortages at major hubs.

intel.title: Gated Community Nuances
intel.text: Many island areas, including Sea Pines and Shipyard, are private resorts. Pedestrian or bike access may be restricted to guests or those paying a daily fee.

intel.title: Sea Turtle Season
intel.text: From May through October, beach lighting is restricted at night to protect nesting turtles. Avoid disturbing marked nests along the dunes.

intel.title: Reliable Urban Coverage
intel.text: Cellular signal is generally strong across the island. Digital navigation is reliable for locating hidden public beach access points.

intel.title: Island vs. Mainland
intel.text: Fuel is available on-island but is often more accessible along Highway 278 in Bluffton before crossing the bridge.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Hilton Head Airport (HHH), pick up your vehicle, and take the 15-minute drive to your rental to drop bags before heading to Coligny.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are ideal; bicycle rentals are the most efficient way to navigate the island's extensive path network.
plan.goldenHour: The Harbour Town pier provides a classic sunset view over the Calibogue Sound, depending on seasonal atmospheric clarity.
